# AEO Studio

> AEO Studio helps brands improve their visibility in AI-generated answers through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): baseline measurement, citation research, competitor analysis, and practical content improvements.

## Service
- Helps brands understand whether they appear in answers to buyer questions across selected AI answer experiences.
- Maps citations and competitor mentions to identify credible sources and content gaps.
- Recommends improvements to brand facts, useful pages, technical discoverability, structured data, and legitimate third-party visibility.
- Uses a repeatable measure, improve, and re-measure workflow.
- Does not guarantee rankings, mentions, citations, leads, or revenue.

## Free technical checker
- Checks public homepage HTML for technical signals including title, meta description, H1 structure, canonical link, JSON-LD presence, indexing directives, image alt attributes, document language, Open Graph metadata, and whether robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt are reachable.
- The checker does not query ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or other answer engines and does not validate schema comprehensively.
